notes.title: Little Wolf update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello all![/h3]

Just a quick update with the game progress;

I have been working a lot on Little Wolf lately, trying to make things more entertaining for the player.

However due to this, I am taking on a large workload and have been wanting to release Little Wolf this year. To do so, I will be releasing this game in English only to being with. 

Little Wolf is essentially a casual exploration, collectathon game with a few boss fights. I am working on making the player have to explore every corner of each map, including vertical travel and swimming.

While this game is casual to play I do think you will enjoy it. 

Any suggestions may be implemented into the game depending on my work load, however I wish to make this a fun game for you all to play!

Thanks for being understanding and patient.

Creed

Winged Lizard 2021.

notes.title: Little Wolf update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

We have been working hard on Little Wolf and have ticked off many things on our 'to do list'.
There are several important things we must do still but the game progression is coming along nicely.

I have uploaded some new, up to date, screenshots as well as a sample of the physics in Little Wolf. 
The game is running smoother on our testers computers now which is a massive win for us as it took some digging to figure out what the cause was.

More detail will be going into the landscape, new scripts, a new area and some new in game secrets for you as Ulf to discover will be added in shortly.

Below here is the link to our facebook page, between steam and facebook there will be updates and information of Little Wolf.

https://www.facebook.com/wingedlizard

Thankyou for reading,

Nate R

Winged Lizard, Little Wolf 2021
